title: Amendment Terms of the Corporate Catering Service Agreement
content:
An order under a Corporate Catering Service Agreement may be amended until the guest count deadline printed against the service level, measured in whole hours before the service start time on the service date.

## Reductions in guest count

> A reduction in guest count inside the free reduction band printed against the service level does not reprice the order; a reduction beyond that band reprices the order to the reduced count, and a reduction asked for after the deadline does not reprice it at all because the food has been bought.

This clause of the amendment terms is **no longer in force**. The free reduction band, the guest count deadline and the increase ceiling printed against each service level all remain valid figures.

## Increases in guest count

An increase in guest count is accepted up to the increase ceiling printed against the service level and reprices the order upward; an increase beyond the ceiling is taken as a second order at the prevailing lead time and surcharges rather than folded into the first.

## Menu and service date

A change of menu package inside the dietary lead hours printed against the service level is not accepted, and a change of service date is handled as a cancellation of the first order and a fresh order on the new day.

## The value an amendment leaves behind

> Every amendment rewrites the order value, and the value that governs any later cancellation charge is the value on the order at the moment notice of cancellation is given.

This clause of the amendment terms is likewise **no longer in force**.

## Amendments against the credit position

An amendment that raises the order value is not accepted while the agreement stands on credit hold, and an amendment that lowers it is accepted whatever the credit position. Which of the two an amendment is turns on the direction in which it moves the order value; the state the agreement stands in is read from the company's own agreement record, and the amendment is correlated to the order by the order reference it carries.

| The amendment | Agreement stands active | Agreement stands on credit hold |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Raises the order value | accepted | not accepted |
| Lowers the order value | accepted | accepted |
